rules.rule_name: NPI Session Continuity - Retrieve NPI from Previous Session
rules.rule_description: When an analyst returns to the Provider Inquiry screen from a previous session, the NPI used in the prior session is automatically retrieved and pre-loaded to avoid re-entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
1:NPI Session Continuity
Retrieve NPI from
Communication Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst is returning to the Provider Inquiry transaction (PINQ) and a previous session exists with a stored NPI in the communication area
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects that a prior session communication area is available (session length is greater than zero)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system automatically retrieves and pre-loads the NPI from the previous session into the current inquiry input field, so the analyst does not need to re-enter it

rules.rule_name: Analyst NPI Input Capture on Provider Inquiry Screen
rules.rule_description: The system accepts the National Provider Identifier (NPI) entered by the analyst on the Provider Inquiry screen (PRVMAP1) as the key input for the provider lookup.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2:Analyst NPI Input Capture
Accept NPI from Analyst
on PINQ Screen PRVMAP1

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst is on the Provider Inquiry screen (PRVMAP1) within the PINQ transaction
acceptance_criteria.When: The analyst submits the screen with an NPI value entered
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system captures the NPI input from the screen and uses it as the search key for the provider master record lookup

rules.rule_name: Provider Master Record Lookup by NPI
rules.rule_description: The system searches the Provider Master File (PRVPROVN) using the NPI submitted by the analyst to retrieve the corresponding provider enrollment record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3:Provider Master Record Lookup
Search Provider Master File
using entered NPI

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted an NPI on the Provider Inquiry screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system performs a lookup against the Provider Master File (PRVPROVN) using the submitted NPI as the unique record identifier
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the full provider record associated with that NPI, or determines that no matching record exists

rules.rule_name: Provider Not Found Handling
rules.rule_description: When the submitted NPI does not match any record in the Provider Master File, the system generates a 'Provider Not Found' message to inform the analyst.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4:Provider Not Found Handling
Generate Provider Not Found
Message for Analyst

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted an NPI on the Provider Inquiry screen and the system has searched the Provider Master File (PRVPROVN)
acceptance_criteria.When: No provider record is found in the Provider Master File matching the submitted NPI
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the display message to 'PROVIDER NOT FOUND' and sends it back to the Provider Inquiry screen to inform the analyst that the NPI does not correspond to any known provider

rules.rule_name: Provider Enrollment Status Determination
rules.rule_description: When a provider record is successfully retrieved, the system evaluates the provider's status flags to classify and determine the current enrollment status of the provider.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
5:Provider Enrollment Status Determination
Evaluate Provider Status Flags
to Classify Enrollment Status

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File using the submitted NPI
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the provider status flags present on the retrieved provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system classifies the provider's enrollment status as one of: ACTIVE, TERMINATED, PENDING, or DENIED, based on which status flag is set on the record

rules.rule_name: Active Provider Identification
rules.rule_description: When the provider record has the Active status flag set, the system identifies and labels the provider as currently enrolled and eligible.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6:Active Provider Identification
Label Provider as ACTIVE
Currently Enrolled and Eligible

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File and the system is evaluating the provider's enrollment status flags
acceptance_criteria.When: The Active status flag (PRV-ACTIVE) is set on the provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the enrollment status display message to 'ACTIVE', indicating the provider is currently enrolled and eligible

rules.rule_name: Terminated Provider Identification
rules.rule_description: When the provider record has the Terminated status flag set, the system identifies and labels the provider as having their enrollment ended.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
7:Terminated Provider Identification
Label Provider as TERMINATED
Enrollment Has Been Ended

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File and the system is evaluating the provider's enrollment status flags
acceptance_criteria.When: The Terminated status flag (PRV-TERMINATED) is set on the provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the enrollment status display message to 'TERMINATED', indicating the provider's enrollment has been ended

rules.rule_name: Pending Provider Identification
rules.rule_description: When the provider record has the Pending status flag set, the system identifies and labels the provider as having an enrollment application currently under review.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
8:Pending Provider Identification
Label Provider as PENDING
Application Under Review

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File and the system is evaluating the provider's enrollment status flags
acceptance_criteria.When: The Pending status flag (PRV-PENDING) is set on the provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the enrollment status display message to 'PENDING', indicating the provider's enrollment application is currently under review

rules.rule_name: Denied Provider Identification
rules.rule_description: When the provider record does not have any recognized enrollment status flag set (Active, Terminated, or Pending), the system classifies the provider's enrollment status as Denied.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9:Denied Provider Identification
Label Provider as DENIED
Enrollment Was Denied

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File and the system is evaluating the provider's enrollment status flags
acceptance_criteria.When: None of the recognized status flags (PRV-ACTIVE, PRV-TERMINATED, PRV-PENDING) are set on the provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the enrollment status display message to 'DENIED', indicating the provider's enrollment was denied or the status is unrecognized

rules.rule_name: Provider Inquiry Results Display to Analyst
rules.rule_description: After determining the provider's enrollment status or generating a not-found message, the system sends the provider record details and the status message back to the Provider Inquiry screen for the analyst to view.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
10:Provider Inquiry Results Display
Send Enrollment Status and
Record Details to PINQ Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed the provider lookup and determined either the enrollment status (ACTIVE, TERMINATED, PENDING, or DENIED) or generated a 'PROVIDER NOT FOUND' message
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is ready to present the results to the analyst
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sends the provider record details along with the corresponding enrollment status message back to the Provider Inquiry screen (PRVMAP1), making the results visible to the analyst

rules.rule_name: Transaction Session Persistence and NPI Retention
rules.rule_description: After displaying the inquiry results, the system retains the NPI in the session communication area and keeps the PINQ transaction active, enabling the analyst to perform subsequent provider lookups without restarting the transaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
11:Transaction Session Persistence
Return Control to PINQ Transaction
Retain NPI in Communication Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has sent the provider inquiry results back to the analyst on the Provider Inquiry screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes the current inquiry cycle
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system returns control to the PINQ transaction, retains the current NPI in the communication area for the next session, and keeps the transaction active and ready to accept the next provider inquiry from the analyst

key_functionalities.title: NPI Session Continuity
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Analyst Returns to\nPINQ Inquiry Screen])
    B{Is This a\nReturn Visit to\nthe Inquiry Screen?}
    C[Retrieve Previously Entered NPI\nfrom Session Memory]
    D[NPI is Now Available\nfor Provider Lookup]
    E[No Previous NPI\nAvailable]

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - Analyst Previously\nUsed This Screen| C
    B -->|No - First Time\non This Screen| E
    C --> D
    D --> F([Proceed with\nProvider Lookup])
    E --> F

rules.rule_name: Detect Analyst Return Visit to Provider Inquiry Screen
rules.rule_description: Determines whether the analyst is returning to the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen from a previous session or accessing it for the first time, by checking whether a prior session context exists.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is This a Return Visit to the Inquiry Screen?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst navigates to the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks whether a prior session context with a previously entered NPI exists from an earlier visit to this screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: If a prior session context exists, the system identifies this as a return visit and proceeds to retrieve the previously entered NPI; if no prior session context exists, the system identifies this as a first-time visit and no NPI is pre-loaded, requiring the analyst to enter an NPI manually

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Previously Entered NPI from Session Memory on Return Visit
rules.rule_description: When an analyst returns to the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen, the system automatically retrieves the NPI that was entered during the previous session and makes it available for the current provider lookup, eliminating the need for the analyst to re-enter the NPI.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Previously Entered NPI from Session Memory

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst returns to the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen and a prior session context containing a previously entered NPI exists
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects that a prior session context is present (session memory is not empty)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the NPI stored in the session memory from the previous visit and loads it into the active NPI input field, making it immediately available for the provider lookup without requiring manual re-entry by the analyst

rules.rule_name: No NPI Pre-Loaded on First Visit to Provider Inquiry Screen
rules.rule_description: When an analyst accesses the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen for the first time within a session, no prior NPI exists in session memory, so the NPI input field remains empty and the analyst must manually enter the NPI to perform a provider lookup.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No Previous NPI Available

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst accesses the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen for the first time in a session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks for a prior session context and determines that no previous session context or NPI exists
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system does not pre-populate the NPI input field, leaving it empty, and the analyst is required to manually enter the NPI to proceed with the provider lookup

rules.rule_name: NPI Available for Provider Lookup After Session Retrieval
rules.rule_description: Once the previously entered NPI has been successfully retrieved from session memory on a return visit, the NPI is confirmed as available and ready to be used for the provider lookup process without any further input from the analyst.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: NPI is Now Available for Provider Lookup

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst has returned to the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen and the system has detected a prior session context containing a previously entered NPI
acceptance_criteria.When: The system successfully retrieves and loads the NPI from the prior session memory into the active NPI input field
acceptance_criteria.Then: The NPI is confirmed as available and ready for use in the provider lookup, and the system proceeds directly to the provider lookup step using the retrieved NPI value without requiring any additional input from the analyst

key_functionalities.title: Analyst NPI Input Capture
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Analyst Opens PINQ\nProvider Inquiry Screen])
    B[Analyst Types National Provider\nIdentifier NPI into\nPRVMAP1 Inquiry Screen]
    C[System Accepts NPI Input\nfrom PRVMAP1 Screen]
    D{NPI\nCaptured\nSuccessfully?}
    E[NPI Ready for\nProvider Master\nRecord Lookup]
    F([Proceed to\nProvider Lookup])

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D -->|Yes - NPI Received| E
    D -->|No - Input Not Received| B
    E --> F

rules.rule_name: State Analyst Initiates Provider Inquiry via PINQ Screen
rules.rule_description: A state analyst opens the PINQ transaction to access the Provider Inquiry screen (PRVMAP1) in order to begin a provider lookup using a National Provider Identifier (NPI).
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Analyst Opens PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: A state analyst needs to look up a provider's enrollment information and initiates the PINQ provider inquiry transaction
acceptance_criteria.When: The analyst opens the PINQ transaction which presents the PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen is displayed and ready to accept a National Provider Identifier (NPI) input from the analyst

rules.rule_name: Pre-Population of NPI from Previous Inquiry Session
rules.rule_description: When a state analyst returns to the PINQ Provider Inquiry screen from a previous session, the NPI used in the prior inquiry is automatically pre-loaded into the input field, eliminating the need to re-enter the same NPI.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Analyst Types National Provider Identifier NPI into PRVMAP1 Inquiry Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: A state analyst is returning to the PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen and a prior NPI value was passed forward from the previous inquiry session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects that a communication area containing a prior NPI exists from the previous session
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system automatically pre-populates the NPI input field on the PRVMAP1 screen with the NPI value carried forward from the previous session, so the analyst does not need to re-enter it

rules.rule_name: System Captures NPI Input Entered by Analyst on PRVMAP1 Screen
rules.rule_description: The system captures the National Provider Identifier (NPI) entered by the state analyst on the PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen to use as the search key for the provider master record lookup.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: System Accepts NPI Input from PRVMAP1 Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen is displayed and the state analyst has typed a National Provider Identifier (NPI) into the NPI input field
acceptance_criteria.When: The analyst submits the PRVMAP1 screen with the entered NPI
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system successfully captures the NPI value entered by the analyst from the PRVMAP1 screen and stores it as the provider lookup key to be used in the provider master record search

rules.rule_name: NPI Successfully Captured and Ready for Provider Master Record Lookup
rules.rule_description: Once the NPI is successfully received from the PRVMAP1 screen, the system confirms the NPI is available and ready to be used as the search key to retrieve the provider's master record from the provider database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: NPI Ready for Provider Master Record Lookup

acceptance_criteria.Given: The state analyst has submitted the PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen with a National Provider Identifier (NPI) entered in the input field
acceptance_criteria.When: The system successfully receives and captures the NPI from the PRVMAP1 screen without any input failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: The captured NPI is confirmed as the provider lookup key and the system proceeds to search the Provider Master database (PRVPROVN) using that NPI to retrieve the matching provider record

rules.rule_name: NPI Input Not Received — Analyst Must Re-Enter NPI
rules.rule_description: If the system does not successfully receive the NPI input from the PRVMAP1 screen, the analyst is required to re-enter the NPI before the provider lookup can proceed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: NPI Captured Successfully?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The state analyst is on the PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen and has attempted to submit an NPI for provider lookup
acceptance_criteria.When: The system fails to capture a valid NPI input from the PRVMAP1 screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system does not proceed to the provider master record lookup and instead returns the analyst to the PRVMAP1 screen to re-enter the National Provider Identifier (NPI)

key_functionalities.title: Provider Master Record Lookup
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Begin Provider Master\nRecord Lookup])
    B[Use Entered NPI as\nUnique Search Key]
    C[(PRVPROVN\nProvider Master File)]
    D[Search Provider Master File\nfor Matching NPI Record]
    E{Matching Provider\nRecord Found?}
    F[Retrieve Provider Enrollment\nRecord and Associated Details]
    G[Provider Record Available\nfor Status Evaluation]
    H[No Matching Record\nfor Entered NPI]
    I([End Provider\nMaster Record Lookup])

    A --> B
    B --> D
    D <-->|Query by NPI Key| C
    D --> E
    E -->|Yes - Record Exists| F
    F --> G
    G --> I
    E -->|No - NPI Not Found| H
    H --> I

rules.rule_name: NPI Used as Unique Provider Lookup Key
rules.rule_description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) entered by the user serves as the sole unique key to identify and retrieve a specific provider's enrollment record from the Provider Master file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Use Entered NPI as Unique Search Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has entered an NPI on the Provider Inquiry screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system initiates a search against the Provider Master file (PRVPROVN)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The entered NPI value (WS-NPI-IN) must be used as the unique record identifier key to locate the provider's enrollment record, ensuring only the exact matching provider record is targeted

rules.rule_name: Provider Master File Search by NPI
rules.rule_description: The system performs a direct lookup against the Provider Master file (PRVPROVN) using the entered NPI as the search key to retrieve the provider's full enrollment record and associated details into the provider working area.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Search Provider Master File for Matching NPI Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid NPI has been entered on the Provider Inquiry screen and is available as the search key
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes a read operation against the Provider Master file (PRVPROVN) using the NPI as the unique record identifier
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the complete provider enrollment record and all associated details into the provider working storage area (WS-PROVIDER-AREA) for further processing and status evaluation

rules.rule_name: Provider Record Successfully Retrieved for Status Evaluation
rules.rule_description: When the Provider Master file lookup returns a successful match for the entered NPI, the system proceeds to evaluate the provider's enrollment status and associated details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Provider Enrollment Record and Associated Details

acceptance_criteria.Given: A search of the Provider Master file (PRVPROVN) has been performed using the entered NPI
acceptance_criteria.When: The Provider Master file confirms a matching provider record exists and the read operation completes successfully (Normal response)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system makes the retrieved provider enrollment record and associated details available and invokes the provider status evaluation process (FORMAT-PROVIDER) to determine and display the provider's current enrollment status

rules.rule_name: No Matching Provider Record Found for Entered NPI
rules.rule_description: When the Provider Master file lookup finds no record matching the entered NPI, the system must inform the user that the provider does not exist in the system.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No Matching Record for Entered NPI

acceptance_criteria.Given: A search of the Provider Master file (PRVPROVN) has been performed using the entered NPI
acceptance_criteria.When: The Provider Master file confirms no matching provider record exists for the entered NPI (Not Found response)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the display message to 'PROVIDER NOT FOUND' to inform the user that no provider enrollment record exists for the entered NPI, and no provider details or status information are displayed

key_functionalities.title: Provider Not Found Handling
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Provider Master File\nLookup Completed])
    B{Did NPI Match\na Provider Record?}
    C[Generate Provider Not Found\nMessage for Analyst]
    D([Display Message\non PINQ Screen])

    A --> B
    B -->|No Match Found\nfor Entered NPI| C
    B -->|Record Found| D
    C --> D

rules.rule_name: Provider NPI Lookup - No Match Found
rules.rule_description: When a user submits an NPI on the Provider Inquiry Screen (PINQ), the system searches the Provider Master File. If no provider record matches the entered NPI, the system must generate a 'Provider Not Found' message to inform the analyst that the NPI does not exist in the system.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Did NPI Match a Provider Record?

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst has entered an NPI on the Provider Inquiry Screen (PINQ) and the system has completed a lookup against the Provider Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: No provider record exists in the Provider Master File that matches the entered NPI
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system generates and displays the message 'PROVIDER NOT FOUND' on the Provider Inquiry Screen (PINQ) to inform the analyst that the entered NPI does not exist in the system

key_functionalities.title: Provider Enrollment Status Determination
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Begin Enrollment\nStatus Determination])
    B{Is Provider\nActive Flag Set?}
    C[Classify Provider\nas ACTIVE\nCurrently Enrolled & Eligible]

    H[Classify Provider\nas DENIED\nEnrollment Was Denied]

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes| C
    B -->|No| D

    D -->|No| F

    C --> Z
    E --> Z

rules.rule_name: Classify Provider as ACTIVE When Active Flag Is Set
rules.rule_description: When a provider record is retrieved and the Active status flag is set, the provider's enrollment status must be classified as ACTIVE, indicating the provider is currently enrolled and eligible.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Provider Active Flag Set? → Classify Provider as ACTIVE Currently Enrolled & Eligible

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider database using the NPI number
acceptance_criteria.When: The provider's Active flag is set to TRUE in the retrieved provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's enrollment status is classified as 'ACTIVE', indicating the provider is currently enrolled and eligible for participation

rules.rule_name: Classify Provider as TERMINATED When Terminated Flag Is Set
rules.rule_description: When a provider record is retrieved and the Active flag is not set but the Terminated status flag is set, the provider's enrollment status must be classified as TERMINATED, indicating the provider's enrollment has been ended.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Provider Terminated Flag Set? → Classify Provider as TERMINATED Enrollment Has Been Ended

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider database using the NPI number, and the provider's Active flag is NOT set
acceptance_criteria.When: The provider's Terminated flag is set to TRUE in the retrieved provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's enrollment status is classified as 'TERMINATED', indicating the provider's enrollment has been ended

rules.rule_name: Classify Provider as PENDING When Pending Flag Is Set
rules.rule_description: When a provider record is retrieved and neither the Active nor the Terminated flag is set, but the Pending status flag is set, the provider's enrollment status must be classified as PENDING, indicating the provider's application is currently under review.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Provider Pending Flag Set? → Classify Provider as PENDING Application Under Review

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider database using the NPI number, and neither the Active flag nor the Terminated flag is set
acceptance_criteria.When: The provider's Pending flag is set to TRUE in the retrieved provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's enrollment status is classified as 'PENDING', indicating the provider's enrollment application is currently under review

rules.rule_name: Classify Provider as DENIED When No Status Flag Is Set
rules.rule_description: When a provider record is retrieved and none of the recognized status flags (Active, Terminated, or Pending) are set, the provider's enrollment status must be classified as DENIED, indicating the provider's enrollment was denied or the status is unrecognized.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No Flags Set → Classify Provider as DENIED Enrollment Was Denied

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider database using the NPI number
acceptance_criteria.When: None of the provider's status flags — Active, Terminated, or Pending — are set in the retrieved provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's enrollment status is classified as 'DENIED', indicating the provider's enrollment was denied or the status does not match any recognized enrollment state

key_functionalities.title: Active Provider Identification
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Begin Provider Status Identification])
    B{Is Provider\nActive Flag Set?}
    C[Label Provider Enrollment\nStatus as ACTIVE\nProvider is Currently Enrolled\nand Eligible]
    D([Pass ACTIVE Status\nfor Display to Analyst])
    E([Check Next\nStatus Flag])

    A --> B
    B -->|Yes - Active Flag is Set| C
    C --> D
    B -->|No - Active Flag Not Set| E

rules.rule_name: Active Provider Status Identification
rules.rule_description: When evaluating a retrieved provider record from the Provider Master file, the system checks the provider's active status flag. If the active flag is set, the provider's enrollment status is classified and labeled as ACTIVE, indicating the provider is currently enrolled and eligible. This is the first status check evaluated in the provider enrollment status determination sequence.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Label Provider Enrollment Status as ACTIVE - Provider is Currently Enrolled and Eligible

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master file (PRVPROVN) using the entered NPI, and the provider enrollment status determination process has begun
acceptance_criteria.When: The provider's Active Status Flag (PRV-ACTIVE) within the retrieved provider record is set to true
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider's enrollment status is labeled as 'ACTIVE', indicating the provider is currently enrolled and eligible, and this ACTIVE status is passed forward for display to the analyst on the PINQ inquiry screen (PRVMAP1); no further status flags are evaluated for this provider record

key_functionalities.title: Terminated Provider Identification
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Enter Status Evaluation\nProvider Record Retrieved])
    B{Is Provider\nActive Flag Set?}
    C{Is Provider\nTerminated Flag Set?}
    D[Label Provider Status\nas TERMINATED\nEnrollment Has Been Ended]
    E([Exit to\nResults Display])

    A --> B
    B -->|No - Active Flag Not Set| C
    B -->|Yes - Active Flag Set| E
    C -->|Yes - Terminated Flag Set| D
    C -->|No - Terminated Flag Not Set| E
    D --> E

rules.rule_name: Skip Terminated Status Check When Provider Is Active
rules.rule_description: When evaluating a retrieved provider record, if the provider's Active flag is already set, the system bypasses the Terminated status check entirely and proceeds directly to display results.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Provider Active Flag Set?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the provider database using the entered NPI number
acceptance_criteria.When: The provider's Active status flag is set to true
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system skips the Terminated flag evaluation and proceeds directly to the results display step without assigning a Terminated label

rules.rule_name: Terminated Provider Status Identification
rules.rule_description: When a retrieved provider record is not active, the system checks whether the provider's Terminated flag is set to determine if the provider's enrollment has been ended.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Provider Terminated Flag Set?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the provider database using the entered NPI number, and the provider's Active status flag is NOT set
acceptance_criteria.When: The provider's Terminated status flag is set to true
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system identifies the provider as Terminated and proceeds to label the provider's enrollment status accordingly

rules.rule_name: Label Provider Enrollment Status as TERMINATED
rules.rule_description: When a provider's Terminated flag is confirmed as set, the system assigns the status label 'TERMINATED' to indicate that the provider's enrollment has been formally ended.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Label Provider Status as TERMINATED
Enrollment Has Been Ended

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the provider database using the entered NPI number, the provider's Active status flag is NOT set, and the provider's Terminated status flag IS set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the provider's enrollment status flags
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the provider status message to 'TERMINATED', indicating that the provider's enrollment has been ended, and this message is prepared for display on the Provider Inquiry Screen

key_functionalities.title: Pending Provider Identification
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD

    F([Return Provider\nStatus as PENDING])

rules.rule_name: Identify Provider with Pending Enrollment Status
rules.rule_description: When evaluating a provider's enrollment status, the system must check whether the provider's pending status flag is set only after confirming the provider is neither Active nor Terminated. If the pending flag is set, the provider is labeled as PENDING, indicating their enrollment application is currently under review.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Provider Pending Flag Set?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider database using the NPI number, AND the provider's Active status flag is NOT set, AND the provider's Terminated status flag is NOT set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the provider's enrollment status flags and finds that the provider's Pending status flag IS set
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system labels the provider's enrollment status as 'PENDING' and returns the status message 'PENDING' to the Provider Inquiry Screen, indicating that the provider's enrollment application is currently under review

key_functionalities.title: Denied Provider Identification
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:

    C --> J

    I --> J

rules.rule_name: Denied Provider Identification Based on Absence of All Enrollment Status Flags
rules.rule_description: When a provider record is retrieved and none of the recognized enrollment status flags (Active, Terminated, or Pending) are set, the provider's enrollment status must be identified and labeled as DENIED, indicating that the provider's enrollment application was denied.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9: Denied Provider Identification
Provider Labeled as DENIED
Enrollment Application Was Denied

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider database using the NPI number entered on the Provider Inquiry Screen, AND the provider record does not have the Active enrollment flag set, AND the provider record does not have the Terminated enrollment flag set, AND the provider record does not have the Pending enrollment flag set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the provider's enrollment status flags and confirms that none of the known enrollment status flags (Active, Terminated, Pending) are set on the provider record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must label the provider's enrollment status as 'DENIED', indicating that the provider's enrollment application was denied, and this 'DENIED' status message must be returned and displayed on the Provider Inquiry Screen to the user

rules.rule_name: Display Provider Not Found Status on Inquiry Screen
rules.rule_description: When a provider lookup by NPI yields no matching record, a 'Provider Not Found' message is prepared and sent to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) to inform the analyst that no provider exists for the given NPI.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Prepare Provider Not Found Message for Display

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted a provider inquiry using an NPI number on the PINQ screen (PRVMAP1)
acceptance_criteria.When: The provider record lookup returns no matching provider for the submitted NPI
acceptance_criteria.Then: The message 'PROVIDER NOT FOUND' is prepared and sent back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) indicating that no provider record exists for the given NPI

rules.rule_name: Display Active Provider Enrollment Status on Inquiry Screen
rules.rule_description: When a provider record is found and the provider's enrollment status is Active, the provider record details along with the 'ACTIVE' status message are prepared and sent to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) for review.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Prepare Provider Record Details with ACTIVE Status for Display

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted a provider inquiry using an NPI number on the PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) and the provider record exists in the provider database
acceptance_criteria.When: The retrieved provider record indicates the provider's enrollment status is ACTIVE
acceptance_criteria.Then: The message 'ACTIVE' is prepared along with the provider record details and sent back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) confirming the provider is currently active and enrolled

rules.rule_name: Display Terminated Provider Enrollment Status on Inquiry Screen
rules.rule_description: When a provider record is found and the provider's enrollment status is Terminated, the provider record details along with the 'TERMINATED' status message are prepared and sent to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) for review.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Prepare Provider Record Details with TERMINATED Status for Display

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted a provider inquiry using an NPI number on the PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) and the provider record exists in the provider database
acceptance_criteria.When: The retrieved provider record indicates the provider's enrollment status is TERMINATED
acceptance_criteria.Then: The message 'TERMINATED' is prepared along with the provider record details and sent back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) indicating the provider's enrollment has been terminated

rules.rule_name: Display Pending Provider Enrollment Status on Inquiry Screen
rules.rule_description: When a provider record is found and the provider's enrollment status is Pending, the provider record details along with the 'PENDING' status message are prepared and sent to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) for review.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Prepare Provider Record Details with PENDING Status for Display

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted a provider inquiry using an NPI number on the PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) and the provider record exists in the provider database
acceptance_criteria.When: The retrieved provider record indicates the provider's enrollment status is PENDING
acceptance_criteria.Then: The message 'PENDING' is prepared along with the provider record details and sent back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) indicating the provider's enrollment is awaiting approval

rules.rule_name: Display Denied Provider Enrollment Status on Inquiry Screen
rules.rule_description: When a provider record is found but the provider's enrollment status does not match any recognized status (Active, Terminated, or Pending), the provider record details along with the 'DENIED' status message are prepared and sent to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) for review.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Prepare Provider Record Details with DENIED Status for Display

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted a provider inquiry using an NPI number on the PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) and the provider record exists in the provider database
acceptance_criteria.When: The retrieved provider record's enrollment status does not match Active, Terminated, or Pending
acceptance_criteria.Then: The message 'DENIED' is prepared along with the provider record details and sent back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) indicating the provider's enrollment status is unrecognized or denied

rules.rule_name: Send Provider Enrollment Status and Record Details to Analyst PINQ Screen
rules.rule_description: Regardless of the determined provider enrollment status outcome (Not Found, Active, Terminated, Pending, or Denied), the prepared provider record details and corresponding status message are always sent back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) to present the inquiry results for review.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Send Provider Enrollment Status and Record Details to Analyst PINQ Screen PRVMAP1

acceptance_criteria.Given: A provider enrollment status and corresponding message have been determined based on the NPI lookup result (Provider Not Found, Active, Terminated, Pending, or Denied)
acceptance_criteria.When: The provider inquiry results are ready to be presented to the analyst
acceptance_criteria.Then: The provider record details and the determined status message are sent to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1), presenting all retrieved provider information for the analyst's review

key_functionalities.title: Transaction Session Persistence
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
