rules.rule_name: Preserve Current NPI in Session Memory for Next Lookup
rules.rule_description: After displaying provider inquiry results, the system retains the current NPI value in the session communication area so it is automatically available for the next provider lookup without requiring the analyst to re-enter it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Preserve Current NPI
in Session Memory
for Next Lookup

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst has completed a provider inquiry and results have been displayed on the PINQ inquiry screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares to return control for the next interaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current NPI value (WS-NPI-IN) is preserved in the session communication area (COMMAREA) so it remains available for the next provider lookup without re-entry

rules.rule_name: Keep Inquiry Session Active and Ready on PINQ Screen
rules.rule_description: After each provider inquiry interaction, the system keeps the PINQ transaction session alive and ready, ensuring the analyst remains on the provider inquiry screen without being logged out or redirected.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Keep Inquiry Session
Active and Ready

acceptance_criteria.Given: An analyst has received provider inquiry results on the PINQ screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes sending the results back to the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system returns control to the PINQ transaction (Transaction ID: PINQ), keeping the inquiry session active and the screen open so the analyst can immediately initiate another provider lookup

rules.rule_name: NPI Available for Next Search Without Re-entry
rules.rule_description: When the analyst initiates a new provider lookup, the previously used NPI is automatically pre-loaded from the session memory into the inquiry input field, eliminating the need to re-enter the NPI manually.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
NPI Available
for Next Search
Without Re-entry

acceptance_criteria.Given: The PINQ inquiry session is active and a prior NPI has been preserved in the session communication area
acceptance_criteria.When: The analyst returns to the provider inquiry screen for a new lookup
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system detects that a communication area exists (session length greater than zero) and automatically loads the previously used NPI into the inquiry input field, making it immediately available for the next search without manual re-entry

rules.rule_name: Session Remains Open on PINQ Screen While Awaiting Analyst Action
rules.rule_description: When the analyst has not yet initiated a new provider lookup after viewing results, the PINQ inquiry session remains open and idle on the screen, waiting for the next action without timing out or closing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Session Remains
Open on PINQ Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: Provider inquiry results have been displayed to the analyst and no new NPI has been entered yet
acceptance_criteria.When: The analyst has not yet initiated a new provider lookup
acceptance_criteria.Then: The PINQ transaction session remains open and active on the inquiry screen, retaining the last used NPI in session memory, and continues to wait until the analyst either enters a new NPI or takes further action

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst is returning to the Provider Inquiry transaction (PINQ) and a previous session exists with a stored NPI in the communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that a prior session communication area is available (session length is greater than zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system automatically retrieves and pre-loads the NPI from the previous session into the current inquiry input field, so the analyst does not need to re-enter it

all_rules.Rule_Name: NPI Session Continuity - Retrieve NPI from Previous Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an analyst returns to the Provider Inquiry screen from a previous session, the NPI used in the prior session is automatically retrieved and pre-loaded to avoid re-entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst is on the Provider Inquiry screen (PRVMAP1) within the PINQ transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The analyst submits the screen with an NPI value entered
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system captures the NPI input from the screen and uses it as the search key for the provider master record lookup

all_rules.Rule_Name: Analyst NPI Input Capture on Provider Inquiry Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system accepts the National Provider Identifier (NPI) entered by the analyst on the Provider Inquiry screen (PRVMAP1) as the key input for the provider lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted an NPI on the Provider Inquiry screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a lookup against the Provider Master File (PRVPROVN) using the submitted NPI as the unique record identifier
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the full provider record associated with that NPI, or determines that no matching record exists

all_rules.Rule_Name: Provider Master Record Lookup by NPI
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system searches the Provider Master File (PRVPROVN) using the NPI submitted by the analyst to retrieve the corresponding provider enrollment record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted an NPI on the Provider Inquiry screen and the system has searched the Provider Master File (PRVPROVN)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No provider record is found in the Provider Master File matching the submitted NPI
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the display message to 'PROVIDER NOT FOUND' and sends it back to the Provider Inquiry screen to inform the analyst that the NPI does not correspond to any known provider

all_rules.Rule_Name: Provider Not Found Handling
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the submitted NPI does not match any record in the Provider Master File, the system generates a 'Provider Not Found' message to inform the analyst.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File using the submitted NPI
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the provider status flags present on the retrieved provider record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system classifies the provider's enrollment status as one of: ACTIVE, TERMINATED, PENDING, or DENIED, based on which status flag is set on the record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Provider Enrollment Status Determination
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a provider record is successfully retrieved, the system evaluates the provider's status flags to classify and determine the current enrollment status of the provider.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File and the system is evaluating the provider's enrollment status flags
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Active status flag (PRV-ACTIVE) is set on the provider record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the enrollment status display message to 'ACTIVE', indicating the provider is currently enrolled and eligible

all_rules.Rule_Name: Active Provider Identification
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the provider record has the Active status flag set, the system identifies and labels the provider as currently enrolled and eligible.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File and the system is evaluating the provider's enrollment status flags
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Terminated status flag (PRV-TERMINATED) is set on the provider record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the enrollment status display message to 'TERMINATED', indicating the provider's enrollment has been ended

all_rules.Rule_Name: Terminated Provider Identification
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the provider record has the Terminated status flag set, the system identifies and labels the provider as having their enrollment ended.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File and the system is evaluating the provider's enrollment status flags
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Pending status flag (PRV-PENDING) is set on the provider record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the enrollment status display message to 'PENDING', indicating the provider's enrollment application is currently under review

all_rules.Rule_Name: Pending Provider Identification
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the provider record has the Pending status flag set, the system identifies and labels the provider as having an enrollment application currently under review.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master File and the system is evaluating the provider's enrollment status flags
Acceptance_Criteria.When: None of the recognized status flags (PRV-ACTIVE, PRV-TERMINATED, PRV-PENDING) are set on the provider record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the enrollment status display message to 'DENIED', indicating the provider's enrollment was denied or the status is unrecognized

all_rules.Rule_Name: Denied Provider Identification
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the provider record does not have any recognized enrollment status flag set (Active, Terminated, or Pending), the system classifies the provider's enrollment status as Denied.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has completed the provider lookup and determined either the enrollment status (ACTIVE, TERMINATED, PENDING, or DENIED) or generated a 'PROVIDER NOT FOUND' message
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is ready to present the results to the analyst
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sends the provider record details along with the corresponding enrollment status message back to the Provider Inquiry screen (PRVMAP1), making the results visible to the analyst

all_rules.Rule_Name: Provider Inquiry Results Display to Analyst
all_rules.Rule_Description: After determining the provider's enrollment status or generating a not-found message, the system sends the provider record details and the status message back to the Provider Inquiry screen for the analyst to view.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has sent the provider inquiry results back to the analyst on the Provider Inquiry screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system completes the current inquiry cycle
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system returns control to the PINQ transaction, retains the current NPI in the communication area for the next session, and keeps the transaction active and ready to accept the next provider inquiry from the analyst

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Session Persistence and NPI Retention
all_rules.Rule_Description: After displaying the inquiry results, the system retains the NPI in the session communication area and keeps the PINQ transaction active, enabling the analyst to perform subsequent provider lookups without restarting the transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst navigates to the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks whether a prior session context with a previously entered NPI exists from an earlier visit to this screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If a prior session context exists, the system identifies this as a return visit and proceeds to retrieve the previously entered NPI; if no prior session context exists, the system identifies this as a first-time visit and no NPI is pre-loaded, requiring the analyst to enter an NPI manually

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Analyst Return Visit to Provider Inquiry Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether the analyst is returning to the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen from a previous session or accessing it for the first time, by checking whether a prior session context exists.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst returns to the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen and a prior session context containing a previously entered NPI exists
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that a prior session context is present (session memory is not empty)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the NPI stored in the session memory from the previous visit and loads it into the active NPI input field, making it immediately available for the provider lookup without requiring manual re-entry by the analyst

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Previously Entered NPI from Session Memory on Return Visit
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an analyst returns to the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen, the system automatically retrieves the NPI that was entered during the previous session and makes it available for the current provider lookup, eliminating the need for the analyst to re-enter the NPI.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst accesses the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen for the first time in a session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system checks for a prior session context and determines that no previous session context or NPI exists
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system does not pre-populate the NPI input field, leaving it empty, and the analyst is required to manually enter the NPI to proceed with the provider lookup

all_rules.Rule_Name: No NPI Pre-Loaded on First Visit to Provider Inquiry Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When an analyst accesses the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen for the first time within a session, no prior NPI exists in session memory, so the NPI input field remains empty and the analyst must manually enter the NPI to perform a provider lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst has returned to the PINQ Provider Inquiry Screen and the system has detected a prior session context containing a previously entered NPI
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system successfully retrieves and loads the NPI from the prior session memory into the active NPI input field
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The NPI is confirmed as available and ready for use in the provider lookup, and the system proceeds directly to the provider lookup step using the retrieved NPI value without requiring any additional input from the analyst

all_rules.Rule_Name: NPI Available for Provider Lookup After Session Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once the previously entered NPI has been successfully retrieved from session memory on a return visit, the NPI is confirmed as available and ready to be used for the provider lookup process without any further input from the analyst.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A state analyst needs to look up a provider's enrollment information and initiates the PINQ provider inquiry transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The analyst opens the PINQ transaction which presents the PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen is displayed and ready to accept a National Provider Identifier (NPI) input from the analyst

all_rules.Rule_Name: State Analyst Initiates Provider Inquiry via PINQ Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: A state analyst opens the PINQ transaction to access the Provider Inquiry screen (PRVMAP1) in order to begin a provider lookup using a National Provider Identifier (NPI).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A state analyst is returning to the PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen and a prior NPI value was passed forward from the previous inquiry session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects that a communication area containing a prior NPI exists from the previous session
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system automatically pre-populates the NPI input field on the PRVMAP1 screen with the NPI value carried forward from the previous session, so the analyst does not need to re-enter it

all_rules.Rule_Name: Pre-Population of NPI from Previous Inquiry Session
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a state analyst returns to the PINQ Provider Inquiry screen from a previous session, the NPI used in the prior inquiry is automatically pre-loaded into the input field, eliminating the need to re-enter the same NPI.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen is displayed and the state analyst has typed a National Provider Identifier (NPI) into the NPI input field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The analyst submits the PRVMAP1 screen with the entered NPI
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system successfully captures the NPI value entered by the analyst from the PRVMAP1 screen and stores it as the provider lookup key to be used in the provider master record search

all_rules.Rule_Name: System Captures NPI Input Entered by Analyst on PRVMAP1 Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system captures the National Provider Identifier (NPI) entered by the state analyst on the PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen to use as the search key for the provider master record lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The state analyst has submitted the PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen with a National Provider Identifier (NPI) entered in the input field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system successfully receives and captures the NPI from the PRVMAP1 screen without any input failure
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The captured NPI is confirmed as the provider lookup key and the system proceeds to search the Provider Master database (PRVPROVN) using that NPI to retrieve the matching provider record

all_rules.Rule_Name: NPI Successfully Captured and Ready for Provider Master Record Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once the NPI is successfully received from the PRVMAP1 screen, the system confirms the NPI is available and ready to be used as the search key to retrieve the provider's master record from the provider database.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The state analyst is on the PRVMAP1 Provider Inquiry screen and has attempted to submit an NPI for provider lookup
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system fails to capture a valid NPI input from the PRVMAP1 screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system does not proceed to the provider master record lookup and instead returns the analyst to the PRVMAP1 screen to re-enter the National Provider Identifier (NPI)

all_rules.Rule_Name: NPI Input Not Received — Analyst Must Re-Enter NPI
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the system does not successfully receive the NPI input from the PRVMAP1 screen, the analyst is required to re-enter the NPI before the provider lookup can proceed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A user has entered an NPI on the Provider Inquiry screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system initiates a search against the Provider Master file (PRVPROVN)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The entered NPI value (WS-NPI-IN) must be used as the unique record identifier key to locate the provider's enrollment record, ensuring only the exact matching provider record is targeted

all_rules.Rule_Name: NPI Used as Unique Provider Lookup Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) entered by the user serves as the sole unique key to identify and retrieve a specific provider's enrollment record from the Provider Master file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid NPI has been entered on the Provider Inquiry screen and is available as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes a read operation against the Provider Master file (PRVPROVN) using the NPI as the unique record identifier
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the complete provider enrollment record and all associated details into the provider working storage area (WS-PROVIDER-AREA) for further processing and status evaluation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Provider Master File Search by NPI
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system performs a direct lookup against the Provider Master file (PRVPROVN) using the entered NPI as the search key to retrieve the provider's full enrollment record and associated details into the provider working area.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A search of the Provider Master file (PRVPROVN) has been performed using the entered NPI
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Master file confirms a matching provider record exists and the read operation completes successfully (Normal response)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system makes the retrieved provider enrollment record and associated details available and invokes the provider status evaluation process (FORMAT-PROVIDER) to determine and display the provider's current enrollment status

all_rules.Rule_Name: Provider Record Successfully Retrieved for Status Evaluation
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Provider Master file lookup returns a successful match for the entered NPI, the system proceeds to evaluate the provider's enrollment status and associated details.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A search of the Provider Master file (PRVPROVN) has been performed using the entered NPI
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Provider Master file confirms no matching provider record exists for the entered NPI (Not Found response)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the display message to 'PROVIDER NOT FOUND' to inform the user that no provider enrollment record exists for the entered NPI, and no provider details or status information are displayed

all_rules.Rule_Name: No Matching Provider Record Found for Entered NPI
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Provider Master file lookup finds no record matching the entered NPI, the system must inform the user that the provider does not exist in the system.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst has entered an NPI on the Provider Inquiry Screen (PINQ) and the system has completed a lookup against the Provider Master File
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No provider record exists in the Provider Master File that matches the entered NPI
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system generates and displays the message 'PROVIDER NOT FOUND' on the Provider Inquiry Screen (PINQ) to inform the analyst that the entered NPI does not exist in the system

all_rules.Rule_Name: Provider NPI Lookup - No Match Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user submits an NPI on the Provider Inquiry Screen (PINQ), the system searches the Provider Master File. If no provider record matches the entered NPI, the system must generate a 'Provider Not Found' message to inform the analyst that the NPI does not exist in the system.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider database using the NPI number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The provider's Active flag is set to TRUE in the retrieved provider record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The provider's enrollment status is classified as 'ACTIVE', indicating the provider is currently enrolled and eligible for participation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Classify Provider as ACTIVE When Active Flag Is Set
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a provider record is retrieved and the Active status flag is set, the provider's enrollment status must be classified as ACTIVE, indicating the provider is currently enrolled and eligible.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider database using the NPI number, and the provider's Active flag is NOT set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The provider's Terminated flag is set to TRUE in the retrieved provider record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The provider's enrollment status is classified as 'TERMINATED', indicating the provider's enrollment has been ended

all_rules.Rule_Name: Classify Provider as TERMINATED When Terminated Flag Is Set
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a provider record is retrieved and the Active flag is not set but the Terminated status flag is set, the provider's enrollment status must be classified as TERMINATED, indicating the provider's enrollment has been ended.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider database using the NPI number, and neither the Active flag nor the Terminated flag is set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The provider's Pending flag is set to TRUE in the retrieved provider record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The provider's enrollment status is classified as 'PENDING', indicating the provider's enrollment application is currently under review

all_rules.Rule_Name: Classify Provider as PENDING When Pending Flag Is Set
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a provider record is retrieved and neither the Active nor the Terminated flag is set, but the Pending status flag is set, the provider's enrollment status must be classified as PENDING, indicating the provider's application is currently under review.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider database using the NPI number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: None of the provider's status flags — Active, Terminated, or Pending — are set in the retrieved provider record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The provider's enrollment status is classified as 'DENIED', indicating the provider's enrollment was denied or the status does not match any recognized enrollment state

all_rules.Rule_Name: Classify Provider as DENIED When No Status Flag Is Set
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a provider record is retrieved and none of the recognized status flags (Active, Terminated, or Pending) are set, the provider's enrollment status must be classified as DENIED, indicating the provider's enrollment was denied or the status is unrecognized.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider Master file (PRVPROVN) using the entered NPI, and the provider enrollment status determination process has begun
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The provider's Active Status Flag (PRV-ACTIVE) within the retrieved provider record is set to true
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The provider's enrollment status is labeled as 'ACTIVE', indicating the provider is currently enrolled and eligible, and this ACTIVE status is passed forward for display to the analyst on the PINQ inquiry screen (PRVMAP1); no further status flags are evaluated for this provider record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Active Provider Status Identification
all_rules.Rule_Description: When evaluating a retrieved provider record from the Provider Master file, the system checks the provider's active status flag. If the active flag is set, the provider's enrollment status is classified and labeled as ACTIVE, indicating the provider is currently enrolled and eligible. This is the first status check evaluated in the provider enrollment status determination sequence.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the provider database using the entered NPI number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The provider's Active status flag is set to true
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system skips the Terminated flag evaluation and proceeds directly to the results display step without assigning a Terminated label

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Terminated Status Check When Provider Is Active
all_rules.Rule_Description: When evaluating a retrieved provider record, if the provider's Active flag is already set, the system bypasses the Terminated status check entirely and proceeds directly to display results.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the provider database using the entered NPI number, and the provider's Active status flag is NOT set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The provider's Terminated status flag is set to true
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system identifies the provider as Terminated and proceeds to label the provider's enrollment status accordingly

all_rules.Rule_Name: Terminated Provider Status Identification
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a retrieved provider record is not active, the system checks whether the provider's Terminated flag is set to determine if the provider's enrollment has been ended.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the provider database using the entered NPI number, the provider's Active status flag is NOT set, and the provider's Terminated status flag IS set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the provider's enrollment status flags
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system sets the provider status message to 'TERMINATED', indicating that the provider's enrollment has been ended, and this message is prepared for display on the Provider Inquiry Screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Label Provider Enrollment Status as TERMINATED
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a provider's Terminated flag is confirmed as set, the system assigns the status label 'TERMINATED' to indicate that the provider's enrollment has been formally ended.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider database using the NPI number, AND the provider's Active status flag is NOT set, AND the provider's Terminated status flag is NOT set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the provider's enrollment status flags and finds that the provider's Pending status flag IS set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system labels the provider's enrollment status as 'PENDING' and returns the status message 'PENDING' to the Provider Inquiry Screen, indicating that the provider's enrollment application is currently under review

all_rules.Rule_Name: Identify Provider with Pending Enrollment Status
all_rules.Rule_Description: When evaluating a provider's enrollment status, the system must check whether the provider's pending status flag is set only after confirming the provider is neither Active nor Terminated. If the pending flag is set, the provider is labeled as PENDING, indicating their enrollment application is currently under review.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider record has been successfully retrieved from the Provider database using the NPI number entered on the Provider Inquiry Screen, AND the provider record does not have the Active enrollment flag set, AND the provider record does not have the Terminated enrollment flag set, AND the provider record does not have the Pending enrollment flag set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the provider's enrollment status flags and confirms that none of the known enrollment status flags (Active, Terminated, Pending) are set on the provider record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must label the provider's enrollment status as 'DENIED', indicating that the provider's enrollment application was denied, and this 'DENIED' status message must be returned and displayed on the Provider Inquiry Screen to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Denied Provider Identification Based on Absence of All Enrollment Status Flags
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a provider record is retrieved and none of the recognized enrollment status flags (Active, Terminated, or Pending) are set, the provider's enrollment status must be identified and labeled as DENIED, indicating that the provider's enrollment application was denied.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted a provider inquiry using an NPI number on the PINQ screen (PRVMAP1)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The provider record lookup returns no matching provider for the submitted NPI
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message 'PROVIDER NOT FOUND' is prepared and sent back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) indicating that no provider record exists for the given NPI

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Provider Not Found Status on Inquiry Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a provider lookup by NPI yields no matching record, a 'Provider Not Found' message is prepared and sent to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) to inform the analyst that no provider exists for the given NPI.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted a provider inquiry using an NPI number on the PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) and the provider record exists in the provider database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The retrieved provider record indicates the provider's enrollment status is ACTIVE
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message 'ACTIVE' is prepared along with the provider record details and sent back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) confirming the provider is currently active and enrolled

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Active Provider Enrollment Status on Inquiry Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a provider record is found and the provider's enrollment status is Active, the provider record details along with the 'ACTIVE' status message are prepared and sent to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) for review.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted a provider inquiry using an NPI number on the PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) and the provider record exists in the provider database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The retrieved provider record indicates the provider's enrollment status is TERMINATED
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message 'TERMINATED' is prepared along with the provider record details and sent back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) indicating the provider's enrollment has been terminated

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Terminated Provider Enrollment Status on Inquiry Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a provider record is found and the provider's enrollment status is Terminated, the provider record details along with the 'TERMINATED' status message are prepared and sent to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) for review.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted a provider inquiry using an NPI number on the PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) and the provider record exists in the provider database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The retrieved provider record indicates the provider's enrollment status is PENDING
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message 'PENDING' is prepared along with the provider record details and sent back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) indicating the provider's enrollment is awaiting approval

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Pending Provider Enrollment Status on Inquiry Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a provider record is found and the provider's enrollment status is Pending, the provider record details along with the 'PENDING' status message are prepared and sent to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) for review.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst has submitted a provider inquiry using an NPI number on the PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) and the provider record exists in the provider database
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The retrieved provider record's enrollment status does not match Active, Terminated, or Pending
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message 'DENIED' is prepared along with the provider record details and sent back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) indicating the provider's enrollment status is unrecognized or denied

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Denied Provider Enrollment Status on Inquiry Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a provider record is found but the provider's enrollment status does not match any recognized status (Active, Terminated, or Pending), the provider record details along with the 'DENIED' status message are prepared and sent to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) for review.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A provider enrollment status and corresponding message have been determined based on the NPI lookup result (Provider Not Found, Active, Terminated, Pending, or Denied)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The provider inquiry results are ready to be presented to the analyst
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The provider record details and the determined status message are sent to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1), presenting all retrieved provider information for the analyst's review

all_rules.Rule_Name: Send Provider Enrollment Status and Record Details to Analyst PINQ Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: Regardless of the determined provider enrollment status outcome (Not Found, Active, Terminated, Pending, or Denied), the prepared provider record details and corresponding status message are always sent back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1) to present the inquiry results for review.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst has completed a provider inquiry and results have been displayed on the PINQ inquiry screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to return control for the next interaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current NPI value (WS-NPI-IN) is preserved in the session communication area (COMMAREA) so it remains available for the next provider lookup without re-entry

all_rules.Rule_Name: Preserve Current NPI in Session Memory for Next Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: After displaying provider inquiry results, the system retains the current NPI value in the session communication area so it is automatically available for the next provider lookup without requiring the analyst to re-enter it.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: An analyst has received provider inquiry results on the PINQ screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system completes sending the results back to the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system returns control to the PINQ transaction (Transaction ID: PINQ), keeping the inquiry session active and the screen open so the analyst can immediately initiate another provider lookup

all_rules.Rule_Name: Keep Inquiry Session Active and Ready on PINQ Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each provider inquiry interaction, the system keeps the PINQ transaction session alive and ready, ensuring the analyst remains on the provider inquiry screen without being logged out or redirected.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The PINQ inquiry session is active and a prior NPI has been preserved in the session communication area
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The analyst returns to the provider inquiry screen for a new lookup
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system detects that a communication area exists (session length greater than zero) and automatically loads the previously used NPI into the inquiry input field, making it immediately available for the next search without manual re-entry

all_rules.Rule_Name: NPI Available for Next Search Without Re-entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the analyst initiates a new provider lookup, the previously used NPI is automatically pre-loaded from the session memory into the inquiry input field, eliminating the need to re-enter the NPI manually.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Provider inquiry results have been displayed to the analyst and no new NPI has been entered yet
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The analyst has not yet initiated a new provider lookup
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The PINQ transaction session remains open and active on the inquiry screen, retaining the last used NPI in session memory, and continues to wait until the analyst either enters a new NPI or takes further action

all_rules.Rule_Name: Session Remains Open on PINQ Screen While Awaiting Analyst Action
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the analyst has not yet initiated a new provider lookup after viewing results, the PINQ inquiry session remains open and idle on the screen, waiting for the next action without timing out or closing.

description:
PRVCICS1 is an online CICS transaction program (transaction ID: PINQ) that supports a Provider Inquiry function for state analysts. It accepts a National Provider Identifier (NPI) entered on a green-screen BMS map, reads the Provider Master VSAM file to retrieve the provider's record, and returns the provider's enrollment status (Active, Terminated, Pending, or Denied) along with their risk tier information to the analyst's screen.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: VSAM (CICS FILE: PRVPROVN) - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: NPI Session Continuity - Retrieve the previously entered NPI from the communication area when the analyst returns to the inquiry screen, enabling seamless continuation of the provider lookup session without re-entering the NPI 2: Analyst NPI Input Capture - Accept the National Provider Identifier (NPI) entered by the state analyst on the PINQ provider inquiry screen (PRVMAP1) to initiate a provider lookup 3: Provider Master Record Lookup - Search the Provider Master file using the entered NPI as the unique key to retrieve the provider's enrollment record and associated details 4: Provider Not Found Handling - When no provider record matches the entered NPI, generate a 'Provider Not Found' message to inform the analyst that the NPI does not exist in the system 5: Provider Enrollment Status Determination - Evaluate the provider's status flags from the retrieved record and classify the provider's enrollment status as one of four states: ACTIVE, TERMINATED, PENDING, or DENIED 6: Active Provider Identification - Identify and label a provider as 'ACTIVE' when the provider's active status flag is set, indicating the provider is currently enrolled and eligible 7: Terminated Provider Identification - Identify and label a provider as 'TERMINATED' when the provider's terminated status flag is set, indicating the provider's enrollment has been ended 8: Pending Provider Identification - Identify and label a provider as 'PENDING' when the provider's pending status flag is set, indicating the provider's enrollment application is under review 9: Denied Provider Identification - Identify and label a provider as 'DENIED' when none of the active, terminated, or pending flags are set, indicating the provider's enrollment was denied 10: Provider Inquiry Results Display - Send the provider's enrollment status and record details back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1), presenting the retrieved provider information for review 11: Transaction Session Persistence - Return control to the PINQ transaction while retaining the NPI in the communication area, keeping the inquiry session active and ready for the next provider lookup
